'''Deviss''', designated '''CT-65/91-6210''', was a [[Clone Captain/Legends|clone trooper captain]] who led [[K Company]], a [[Company/Legends|unit]] within [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Bly/Legends|Bly's]] [[327th Star Corps/Legends|327th Star Corps]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Deviss served in the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|first battle]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]. During the battle, Deviss risked [[Gender/Legends|his]] life to protect two injured [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] from [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[DSD1 dwarf spider droid/Legends|spider droids]] and received a medal after being rescued from behind enemy lines by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Troop/Legends|troops]]. He went on to fight in the [[Battle of Altyr V]], after which he was promoted to [[Commander/Legends|commander]] for his actions. He also participated in a [[Siege of Cato Neimoidia|battle]] on [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]]. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Deviss was dispatched to support [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Nem Bees]] on [[Orto/Legends|Orto]]. During the ensuing [[Battle of Orto|battle]] on the planet, the commander received [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]]&mdash;which called for all [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] to [[Death/Legends|execute]] their [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Officer/Legends|officers]]&mdash;and personally shot down Bees on the front lines.

==Biography==
===Clone Wars===
Like all [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]],<ref name="SWE" /> CT-65/91-6210, who adopted the nickname "Deviss,"<ref name="gar" /> was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] as a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]]<ref name="SWE" /> of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]].<ref name="clone troopers" /> After [[flash training]] on Kamino, Deviss was given the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Clone Captain/Legends|captain]] and became the leader of [[K Company]], a [[Company/Legends|unit]] within the [[Hawkbat Battalion]] of the [[327th Star Corps/Legends|327th Star Corps]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> when the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] broke out on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] planet [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], Deviss served in the ensuing [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|battle]]. During the fight, Deviss and Hawkbat [[Battalion/Legends|Battalion]] were ordered to march directly into the withering [[Laser/Legends|fire]] of Separatist [[DSD1 dwarf spider droid/Legends|spider droids]]. The battalion was almost completely wiped out, and Deviss risked [[Gender/Legends|his]] life to stay behind in a shallow bomb crater, tending to two critically injured [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]]. He defended their position as [[Spider/Legends|spider]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]] passed overhead, and, after three [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]], a rescue casevac team arrived. After his men were rescued, Deviss received a medal and a new mission.<ref name="gar" />

Later during the war, Deviss took part in the [[Battle of Altyr V]], during which Deviss' [[Unidentified Jedi General (Altyr V)|Jedi General]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by enemy fire, leaving Deviss to improvise a new plan of attack. Deviss rallied the remaining clone [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] companies before destroying a Separatist [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]] emplacement, opening the battlefield to [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|aerial bombardment]] and winning the battle for the Republic. For this act of bravery and initiative, [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Bly/Legends|Bly]], promoted Deviss to the rank of [[Commander/Legends|commander]]. His promotion allowed Deviss to wear the [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC]] [[Pauldron/Legends|pauldron]] and a [[Kama/Legends|''kama'']], as well as a special [[Macrobinoculars/Legends|macrobinocular]] [[Armor/Legends|helmet]] attachment.<ref name="gar" /> In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Deviss served in the [[Siege of Cato Neimoidia|raid]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|187|Deviss, Clone Commander}}</ref> of the Separatist-controlled<ref name="LoE">''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''</ref> [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]<ref name="TCWCG">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref> world [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]],<ref name="CSWE" /> which ended with a Republic victory.<ref name="LoE" />

===Order 66===
As the war neared its end, Deviss was dispatched to the planet [[Orto/Legends|Orto]] to support [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Nem Bees]] in the upcoming [[Battle of Orto|battle]] there. Bees managed to gain access to a [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] transceiver, with which he established contact with the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic forces]], and Deviss was ordered to arrive with his battalion of clone soldiers in-[[Orto system/Legends|system]] at a designated [[Time/Legends|time]]. Bees disabled the planet's [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]] just as the Republic strike force emerged from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. Deviss rendezvoused with Bees as the Republic forces landed, and together they began the task of removing the entrenched droid [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|armies]]. After a [[Standard week/Legends|week]] of fighting, [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]]<ref name="db">{{DB|character|nembees|Bees, Nem}}</ref>&mdash;a [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|command]] for all clone troopers to execute their [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Officer/Legends|officers]]<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref>&mdash;was issued. While Bees led an attack on the enemy lines, Deviss carried out the order, shooting and killing the Jedi Knight.<ref name="db" />

==Personality and traits==
Deviss survived many battles during the Clone Wars and was a capable leader. Even after his [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] was killed on [[Altyr V]], he managed to rally his [[Troop/Legends|troops]] and win the battle for the Republic. The commander also showed his bravery when he defended wounded comrades on Geonosis by himself, receiving a medal for his actions.<ref name="gar" /> Deviss was loyal to [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and the Republic, as he gunned down his [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding]] Jedi General during Order 66.<ref name="db" /> As a clone of Jango Fett,<ref name="clone troopers" /> Deviss stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall.<ref name="SWE" />

==Equipment==
Deviss wore red-striped [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase II clone armor]]<ref name="rots">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> and, after his promotion, was allowed to use<ref name="gar" /> a ''kama'', polarized macrobinoculars as a helmet attachment, and a red pauldron. His quick-release [[Holster/Legends|holster]] held two [[DC-17 hand blaster/Legends|DC-17 hand blasters]], and he also carried a [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A blaster rifle]].<ref name="rots" /> Additionally, Deviss was equipped with a [[Rope/Legends|rope]] and a [[Grappling hook/Legends|grappling hook]].<ref name="Deviss action figure 2005">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (toy line)|pack=#33: Clone Commander (Battle Gear!) (Red)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/rots0533clonecmdr.asp}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
For [[George Lucas]]' [[2005]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], the digital model of Clone Commander Bly was originally slated to have red armor markings, but his design was changed to yellow to better match the [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] environment in which he appears.<ref name="bly">{{DB|character|commanderbly|Bly, Commander}}</ref> The "red Bly" model was nonetheless featured, without name, in ''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]''<ref name="rots" /> and became the basis for a clone trooper action figure in [[Hasbro]]'s [[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (toy line)|''Revenge of the Sith'' toy line]] despite never appearing in the film.<ref name="bly" />

The article ''[[Guide to the Grand Army of the Republic]]'', written by authors [[Karen Traviss]] and [[Ryan Kaufman (real person)|Ryan Kaufman]] for [[Star Wars Insider 84|''Star Wars Insider'' 84]] in [[September]] 2005, first provided the "red Bly" character with a unique name and clone designation number&mdash;"Deviss" and CT-65/91-6210.<ref name="gar" /> Kaufman revealed through the [[Star Wars: Blogs]] feature that he named Deviss after Traviss herself.<ref name="name">{{Blog|RyanKaufman|8|What's In a Name?}}</ref> For the [[StarWars.com]] ''[[What's The Story?]]'' writing contest, [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] member [[Kyle Jewhurst|"Lord Hydronium"]] established Deviss' role in Order 66. The story was published in the Nem Bees StarWars.com [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entry.<ref name="db" /> Deviss also received a subsequent character entry in the [[2008]] ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="CSWE" />
